remarks: Located on the West side with open floor plan! Features Canadian skyline, nightly firework shows and seasonal views of Niagara River and upper rapids.  Comfortable Living in the Heart of Niagara Falls.  Discover comfortable, convenient living in this well-maintained and secure building in the city of Niagara Falls. With elevator service. this property offers an easy, low-maintenance lifestyle in a fantastic location. The building features common floor laundry facilities on the floor, medical services within the building, and common fees include heat, electric and water, exercise room and use of the Community room/business presentation area with a full kitchen. Public transportation is just a short walk away. Enjoy the convenience of being within walking distance of the Goat Island, Canadian border, (Rainbow Bridge) local shops, restaurants, and the Seneca Niagara Casino. The property offers beautiful surroundings and easy access to scenic areas (Niagara Falls, Niagara Gorge) perfect for walking, jogging, biking and enjoying the outdoors. Whether you're looking for a comfortable home, a convenient getaway, or a seasonal residence for snowbird living, this property offers an appealing combination of security, convenience, location, and lifestyle.
